fixture: Harbour City Waves vs Metro Kings
selection_note: Approved items were replayed together for this trial, including older Game 2 content. The unapproved external item is comparison material and was excluded from processing.

items.title: Metro Kings level Finals with 101-98 Game 2 win
items.body: The Metro Kings beat the Harbour City Waves 101-98 to level the Championship Finals at 1-1. Malik Grant led the Kings with 28 points and eight rebounds.

items.title: Watch Malik Grant's 28-point performance in Game 2
items.body: Video highlights from Malik Grant's 28-point performance as the Metro Kings won Game 2 101-98 and tied the Finals at one game each.

items.title: Medical update: Elias Cole questionable for Game 3
items.body: Guard Elias Cole is questionable for Game 3 after sustaining soreness in his left ankle. He will be assessed after the team's final practice and remains a game-time decision.

items.title: Game 3 tipoff moved to 20:00
items.body: Tipoff for Game 3 of the Championship Finals has moved from 19:30 to 20:00 local time because of an updated broadcast schedule. Arena doors will still open at 17:30.

items.title: Tayo Mensah ties Waves playoff assists record
items.body: Tayo Mensah recorded 12 assists in Game 2, tying the Harbour City Waves' franchise record for assists in a playoff game. The Aurora Basketball League playoff record is 17.

items.title: Win a signed Malik Grant jersey with Northbank Insurance
items.body: Supporters who request a Northbank Insurance quote before Friday will enter a draw to win a signed Malik Grant jersey. Terms and conditions apply.

items.title: Game 3 fan zone opens at 17:30
items.body: The Championship Finals fan zone will open outside Harbour Arena at 17:30. It will include player interviews on the main screen, food stalls and activities for younger fans.

items.title: Coach Rivera: lineup decisions will follow final practice
items.body: Waves coach Lena Rivera said no Game 3 lineup decisions had yet been confirmed and that player availability would be reviewed after final practice.

items.title: Game 3 preview: how the Waves can slow Malik Grant
items.body: The broadcast team reviews the defensive adjustments Harbour City may make after Malik Grant scored 28 points in Game 2.

items.title: Sources: Elias Cole expected to miss Game 3
items.body: Two people described as being close to the team expect Elias Cole to miss Game 3. The Harbour City Waves have not confirmed his status.
